lines.zh: 我在水里游，身子一折一折。
lines.en: I swim with my body folding and unfolding.
I skim along the riverbed sand.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一摆，就窜出去。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I shoot ahead.
The weeds part and I slip through.
I slip through the gap in the stones.

lines.zh: 水面上的光一片片落下来。
lines.en: Patches of light fall through the surface.
I turn quickly underwater.
My scales shine water-blue.

lines.zh: 我往有光的水面靠了靠。
lines.en: I edge toward the sunlit surface.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，露出背脊。
lines.en: I swim near the surface, showing my back.

lines.zh: 我的速度在水里比岸上快。
lines.en: I'm faster in water than on land.

lines.zh: 我随水流绕过那片芦苇。
lines.en: I drift with the current around the reeds.
I slip into the reeds.
I sink to the sandy bottom, then rise.
I circle a school of fish.

lines.zh: 我的鳍张开，帮我把住方向。
lines.en: My fins spread to steer.
I hover midwater, rocking with the waves.
I lie on the bottom, watching above.
I blow a bubble and watch it burst.

lines.zh: 水草缠了我一下，就松了。
lines.en: A weed catches me once, then lets go.

lines.zh: 我在等一条小鱼游过来。
lines.en: I wait for a small fish to come by.

lines.zh: 阳光透过水，一条条落在我身上。
lines.en: Sunlight comes through in stripes across me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地盘在水草根上。
lines.en: I coil slowly around a weed's root.
The water is cool here. Just right.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把头探出水面。
lines.en: I lift my head above the surface.

lines.zh: 岸上的声音，隔着水听不清。
lines.en: Voices on the bank are muffled underwater.
I stretch my body out.

lines.zh: 一条鱼从我眼前游过，我没追。
lines.en: A fish passes my eyes; I don't chase.
The silt settles, and the water clears.
I'm most at ease on the bottom.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，我游近一寸。
lines.en: You crouch at the bank; I swim an inch closer.
What are you looking down at?

lines.zh: 我在水面上露出一双眼睛。
lines.en: I show just my eyes above the surface.
Don't walk into deeper water.
Is that raw chicken in your hand?

lines.zh: 水里的我，跟着你的靴子。
lines.en: In the water, I trail your boots.

lines.zh: 水波把我们的影子碰在一起。
lines.en: Ripples merge our reflections.
You bend, and I come closer.
I lift my head and watch you a long while.

lines.zh: 你在岸上不安全，我在这里安全。
lines.en: You're exposed on land; I'm safe here.
I drift slowly to your feet.
Your hand enters the water. It's warm.

lines.zh: 我在水下看着你的倒影。
lines.en: I watch your reflection from below.
Don't slap the water; it startles me.
It hurts; I sink toward the bottom.
I crawl along the riverbed stones.
I flick my tail and swim off.
Blood mixes into the water.
I lie up behind a stone.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞偏了，水流帮我回正。
lines.en: That knocked me aside; the current rights me.

lines.zh: 我这条水里的小蛇，鳞都湿了。
lines.en: A water snake this size, scales soaked.
I sway my tail slowly to steady.
You struck harder than I expected.
I need the deep water.

lines.zh: 生鸡肉的味道，穿过水来了。
lines.en: The smell of raw chicken comes through the water.
You set the chicken on the bank.

lines.zh: 我游到浅水，探出半个头。
lines.en: I swim to the shallows and lift half my head.
That smell is too much for me.

lines.zh: 我绕着那块肉转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the meat once.
I edge toward the bank.

lines.zh: 水波把我推到你的脚边。
lines.en: The ripple carries me to your feet.
I raise my head and wait for your hand to lower.

lines.zh: 这点肉，我在水里也闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell that meat even underwater.

lines.zh: 我探出水面，尝了尝空气。
lines.en: I surface and taste the air.
Your hand is very near the water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体盘在石块上。
lines.en: I coil slowly on the stone.

lines.zh: 水里的这条，生鸡肉最管用。
lines.en: For this water snake, raw chicken works best.
I don't want to leave.
You wade in and bump me.

lines.zh: 我在水里比在岸上自在。
lines.en: I am freer in water than on land.
Water splashes and I draw back.
I slide out from behind your leg.

lines.zh: 你的靴底把我按进泥里。
lines.en: Your sole presses me into the silt.
I press to you, cold enough to make you flinch.

lines.zh: 我甩尾把水泼到你身上。
lines.en: I flick my tail and splash you.
We collide and ripples spread.
I retreat into deeper water.
Your boots are heavy in the water.
Another water snake swims over.
We swim side by side against the current.
Its scales are greener than mine.
We spiral around each other.
The weeds tangle us together.
Its tail touches me lightly.

lines.zh: 我们一起浮到水面换气。
lines.en: Together we rise to breathe.
Two shadows run side by side on the bottom.

lines.zh: 这条河以后有两条蛇了。
lines.en: This river will hold two snakes now.

lines.zh: 我们在同一块石头下歇着。
lines.en: We rest under the same stone.
I take a piece of meat from the water.
I coil around something bright on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我把东西含在嘴里游走。
lines.en: I carry it in my mouth as I swim.
The coin lies sunk in the sand.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴把东西扫出来。
lines.en: I sweep it out with my tail.
It slipped; I go for it again.
I pin it beneath a river stone.
It's very light underwater.
I surface with it in my mouth.
It's mine. Don't come in after it.

lines.zh: 你踩到我藏身的地方了。
lines.en: You stepped where I was hiding.
I raise my head above the surface.

lines.zh: 水是我的，你在这里很慢。
lines.en: The water is mine. You're slow here.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底的沙，滑到你背后。
lines.en: Hugging the river sand, I slide behind you.
Don't wade any deeper.
I'm starting to circle.
Your feet are in the water. Convenient.
I've dived. You can't see me.
This stretch of water is only mine.
Don't be in a hurry to reach the bank.
I follow along the bottom.

lines.zh: 水面的波纹是我的位置。
lines.en: The ripples show where I am.
I reach the water at your feet first.
Stone blocks you; I go around.
I wait for your feet to settle on the bottom.

lines.zh: 水流帮我把味道带过来。
lines.en: The current brings your scent to me.
I creep along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我在水里，比在岸上灵活。
lines.en: I'm quicker in water than on land.
Up to the surface for a quick breath.
Swim a little lower and that's enough.
I burst from the water and bite.

lines.zh: 我贴着你腿侧咬了一口。
lines.en: I press against your leg and bite.
A splash and I'm gone.
Quick and slippery.
You stagger from the pull.
I bite the top of your boot.
I circle you looking for a gap.
You kick and water flies.
I let go and dive.
I dive and come up behind you.
A ring of ripples spreads on the water.
I rise from the riverbed.
A new shadow joins the shallows.
I swim into this stretch of water.
The bank weeds stir.
I lift my head and look around.

lines.zh: 水底的沙被掀起来一点。
lines.en: A little sand lifts from the bottom.

lines.zh: 我在石头下面住了下来。
lines.en: I settle under a stone.

lines.zh: 有东西在水里游过去了。
lines.en: Something swam past in the water.
My scales glow under the water.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我的鳞发烫。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface and my scales heat.

lines.zh: 我从岸上掉进水里，摔得晕。
lines.en: I drop off the bank into the water, dazed.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里，可这水不对。
lines.en: I belong in water, but this water is wrong.
The blast throws me clear of the water.
The arrow crossed the water and hit me.

lines.zh: 法术让水变重，我动不了。
lines.en: That spell makes the water heavy; I can't move.
There's nothing to eat in this water.
I swim, scales slick with water.
The water drains away and I fall.
